remarks: Convenience and maintenance free living at it's best! This 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhouse is located within walking distance to South Norwalk and the SONO Collection; 1 mile to Metro North and a short drive for access to I95, RT 7, the Merritt Parkway and all of your local shopping and dining needs. The main level has an open flow for easy entertaining. Galley kitchen features shaker-style kitchen cabinets, granite counters and stainless steel appliances. The dining area has sliders out to your own private deck. Head upstairs to the primary bedroom suite with ensuite bathroom including tiled shower & whirlpool tub. A 2nd bedroom, hall bath and laundry closet, just steps outside your bedrooms doors, completes this floor. The extra-large 3rd floor bedroom can also be used as a playroom, media room, home office, art studio, etc. The lower level has a 2 car attached garage with ample storage space. You don't want to miss this one. Set up an appointment to preview today!
